title: Aurora - 24h Migraine Prediction (Official Demo | Junction 2025)
desc:
Aurora predicts migraine risk 24 hours before symptoms - using passive smartphone signals and zero manual input.
This 19-second demo shows the core experience: quiet detection, one-tap setup, and clinically grounded early warnings.

Aurora analyzes:
• sleep disruption (screen rhythm)
• stress markers (typing changes)
• activity deviation (step patterns)
• barometric pressure shifts
• daily intensity (work/rest patterns)

Built for the Pfizer × Aava Migraine Challenge at Junction 2025.
